title: 代码变更验证与修复建议
frequency: 每次 PR / 发布
summary: 读取变更、运行既有校验、归纳失败原因，并产出可执行的修复建议。
agentLoop: PR 或构建失败触发 → 定位受影响文件 → 执行测试、lint 与类型检查 → 汇总证据 → 人工批准修复或合并。
successMetric: 减少人工排查时间；以首次通过率、回归缺陷率和平均修复时长衡量。
guardrail: 只运行仓库允许的命令；不得自动合并、发布或修改生产配置。

title: 客服工单分流与升级
frequency: 持续、高并发
summary: 识别意图、紧急程度和账户上下文，将工单路由至正确队列并准备回复草稿。
agentLoop: 新工单进入 → 提取主题与风险信号 → 分类、去重、补全上下文 → 分派或生成草稿 → 人工发送与抽检。
successMetric: 缩短首次响应时间，提升一次解决率并降低错误升级率。
guardrail: 涉及退款、隐私、法律或安全事件时必须升级人工；Agent 不直接承诺补偿。

title: 安全告警证据归并与初步调查
frequency: 持续监控
summary: 把分散的告警、日志和资产信息归并为可审阅的调查包，帮助分析师优先处理高风险事件。
agentLoop: 告警触发 → 拉取允许范围内的上下文 → 关联相似事件与资产 → 生成证据时间线 → 安全分析师裁决。
successMetric: 缩短平均分诊时间，提高有效告警占比与调查证据完整度。
guardrail: 仅只读访问获授权的数据源；不得自行隔离资产、封禁账号或删除证据。

title: 文档转结构化业务流程
frequency: 每次政策、合同或流程更新
summary: 从规范、合同或操作手册中提取字段、步骤、例外和待确认项，生成可审阅的结构化工作项。
agentLoop: 上传或更新文档 → 提取关键字段和规则 → 标出不确定项与引用位置 → 人工确认 → 写入目标系统。
successMetric: 降低录入耗时与遗漏率，衡量字段准确率和人工修改率。
guardrail: 保留来源页码与引用；合同解释、法律结论和最终写入必须由授权人员确认。

title: 销售账户研究与会前准备
frequency: 每次重点会面

successMetric: 提高准备覆盖率、跟进及时率和有效会议转化率。
guardrail: 不得从非授权来源抓取个人数据；简报不得替代 CRM 中的人工事实核验。

title: 数据质量异常定位与修复提案
frequency: 每次数据管道运行

agentLoop: 质量规则失败 → 对比历史与上游变更 → 生成异常说明、影响范围和修复 SQL 草案 → 数据负责人审核执行。
successMetric: 缩短异常恢复时间，降低重复故障与错误数据影响范围。

Stored PromptOwl credentials live in the OS keyring (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service via `secret-tool`). With no keyring (headless/CI/Docker), set `CONTEXTNEST_CREDENTIALS_KEY` and they go to `~/.promptowl/credentials.enc.json` (AES-256-GCM, scrypt-derived key, mode 0600). Never plaintext: a legacy `~/.promptowl/credentials.json` is migrated on first read, then overwritten and deleted; with neither keyring nor key the CLI stops and says how to fix it. `PROMPTOWL_ACCESS_TOKEN` skips storage entirely.

taskEvidence: Multi-agent orchestration for AI coding assistants

The industry has caught on to what agent-native developers already knew: the unit of AI-assisted work isn't the prompt, it's the **loop** — act, verify, correct, go again. Models write better prompts than we do now; the scarce skill is designing the loop that keeps agents pointed at the goal, and the verifier that decides whether the work is actually done.
outcomeEvidence: The Flywheel is the part most tools don't have. It doesn't run tasks — it runs **revolutions**: every pass around the loop either ships the work or surfaces a defect that gets filed and fixed. It's the loop that improves the loop, and it's how most of Overdeck itself gets built.

- **The right model for every phase.** A frontier model plans the architecture, faster models write the code and handle mechanical steps. Overdeck routes automatically — or you override with two clicks when you know better.
sceneEvidence: Multi-agent orchestration for AI coding assistants

IDEs were built for humans who type code. Overdeck is built for humans who **direct** it — not with prompts, with **loops**. One agent or twenty, hands-on or hands-off: spawn agents on real issues, watch every diff land live, steer mid-task, and let a built-in specialist pipeline review, test, and merge the work — while you decide exactly how much of the loop runs without you.

taskEvidence: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Upload-Post — publish, schedule, analyze and manage social media from any MCP-compatible AI agent.

Lets any MCP-compatible AI agent (ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, …) publish, schedule, analyze and manage social media across **TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Reddit, Bluesky, X, Google Business, Discord, Telegram and more** with a single API key.
outcomeEvidence: - `get_post_comments` — top-level comments on a post, or, with `commentId`, the replies under one of them (TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn Page posts; LinkedIn prefers the full `comment_urn`). Reads are cached for up to 60 seconds (up to 2 minutes on X); a comment created or deleted through Upload-Post by the same account shows up on the next read.

`get_media` and `get_cached_post_analytics` are cursor-paginated: feed the response's `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until `has_more` is false. LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram do not support media cursors and accept `limit` only. Prefer `get_cached_post_analytics` over `get_post_analytics` when scanning many posts — it replays previously fetched results and so avoids the live analytics rate limit of 100 requests / 5 minutes. Only contains posts previously fetched through a live per-post endpoint; there is no background refresh, so captured_at is the last time that post was read live.
sceneEvidence: Upload-Post is a plugin reviewed by OpenAI, listed in ChatGPT's **Plugins** (formerly Apps). [Open Upload-Post in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a1fed02ff5c8191b4060c5807221f26) or search for *Upload-Post* in **Plugins**, click **Install**, then **Connect**, and sign in with OAuth. There is no MCP URL to paste, and you get the [Upload Studio](#chatgpt-video-upload-ui) widget for publishing video files, photos and carousels straight from your computer. OpenAI dots use the same plugin: select it in your dot's **Customize → Plugins** and review its permissions.

One server covers every network; this is what each of the big five uses. Publishing always goes through the same upload tools with a `platform` list, so a single call can post one video to TikTok, Reels and Shorts at once.

audioEvidence: **Eyeline teleprompter.** Read your script on screen, follow it with your voice, and record the microphone feed in real time. Flag flubbed lines without breaking flow, tag multiple attempts for the same section, and optionally mirror the display to a second screen over your local network so you can read from wherever the camera points. **Eyeline Edit.** A review surface for the cut. Scrub waveforms, inspect word-level timings, trim cut edges against the source, relink camera originals when proxies drift, and export finished video or audio. Cuts stay linked to their original source intervals, so nothing you trim is ever lost — full handles remain available for the final editor.
